messages:
ashley: Proposal: tighten edge TLS profiles (block RC4/3DES, disable TLS1.0/1.1) and enable TLS1.3-only for internal-e2e. Plan staged canaries across na/eu/ap.

ben: note: last RBAC change tightened KMS decrypt perms yesterday; saw intermittent 503s in canary earlier. could be related.

maria: checked audit logs 7:12 UTC: several cryptoKeyVersions.access denies from keystore when proxies tried unwrap.

liam: root cause: deploy removed impersonation path. keystore now only allows keystore-sa, but proxies still call via edge-proxy-sa and expected keystore to impersonate.

ashley: action: do a hotfix to restore impersonation binding to clear customer impact, then plan secure migration (proxies call keystore as keystore-sa) within 2 weeks. rollback window 60m.

devops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-2451 proxy-keystore-decrypt (P2).

sam: for TLS rollout: canary na-west internal-services only, track TLSVersion + CipherSuite in traces, alert if >1% handshake failures. also run synthetic legacy SDK clients pre-rollout.

maria: i'll draft runbook steps and include IAM snapshot + commands to re-add impersonation: `gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding keystore@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --member="serviceAccount:edge-proxy-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator"`

ben: additional ops: add OCSP stapling rate-limiter, update proxy config templates, and create canary job that exercises java-8-legacy and go1.12 TLS stacks.

liam: owners: hotfix  liam, runbook maria, canary sam. proceed with hotfix now; flip TLS canary after 15m stable.

ashley: communication: CC customer-success + infra owners, banner on dashboard about TLS deprecations and migration docs.
